title: Hearty Light Malaysian Speck Tagine
description: A garlicky and romantic Malaysian dish featuring speck, made vegan-friendly by using plant-based speck alternatives, and cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine

ingredients.name: plant-based speck
ingredients.notes: use a vegan-friendly alternative to traditional speck

instructions: Heat the ceramic tagine over medium heat and add the minced garlic, cooking for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the plant-based speck and cook for 2 minutes until lightly browned
Add the coconut milk, vegetable broth, and brown rice to the tagine, stirring to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
Use a pressure cooker to cook the tagine for an additional 10 minutes, or until the rice is tender
Stir in the chopped fresh cilantro and serve hot
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired
